Los Angeles Department of Transportation report and Resolution relative to apply for, and accept, grant funding from the California Department of Transportation in connection ) to purchase and install electrical infrastructure for bus electrification at the City-owned Sylmar Bus Maintenance Yard located at 12776 Foothill Boulevard in connection with the Fiscal Year 2026-27 State of Good Repair Program.

Yes
